market.subtitle: Apparel, footwear and home goods brands need product, retailer EDI and books in one system

competitors.name: Aptean
competitors.rationale: Industry-specific ERP with PLM for mid-market and enterprise apparel and footwear firms across many industries

competitors.name: BlueCherry
competitors.rationale: Fits manufacturers that own production with PLM, EDI and shop floor control, with no financials cited

competitors.name: AIMS360
competitors.rationale: Apparel ERP with native EDI and accounting that fits brands from about $1 million to $400 million in sales

competitors.name: ApparelMagic
competitors.rationale: ERP, PLM, CRM and B2B ecommerce in one platform aimed at growth-stage fashion teams

competitors.name: InStyle Apparel Software
competitors.rationale: Apparel ERP for manufacturing and distribution with PDM, MRP and EDI, with no financials cited

our_take.headline: Ai2000 runs PLM, EDI, warehouse and the books natively for global fashion houses
points: Small-brand tools stop short of global fashion house programs
Large-brand suites lack financials or spread across many industries
